Posted in a wonky order, but my Zippo was getting worn out, the paint had scratches the words were almost unreadable, so I sanded and brushed the brass then treated it with electrolosis to get a nice patina going so its not so shiny.

All you need to do this is a cup of vinegar and salt diluted until it wont dilute anymore(I've heard salt and water works too) a couple lead wires and a 9V battery(I like to use 2) and a Q-tip.

ground one wire onto the object the object and one onto the base of a q-tip make sure it clips to some cotton to get a wicking effect through the circuit. and connect the other ends to the batteries and dip the swab into the vinegar and salt and draw/dab like a pen.

Tips on polarity and effects.

If I hook the Positive to the pen and the Negative to the object I get a super dark almost black colour, I found it too much so I swapped leads. with the Negative to the pen and Positive to the object I got a lighter patina and if I rest the metal clip and the cotton onto the surface at the same time it brings out the pinks.

So mess around a bit and find what works best for you, but it's simple and easy works best on brass and copper but works on stainless and other steels too usually to some degree.
